notes: You can now delete your own admin notes, after a confirmation. Notes typed in the web admin are no longer credited to whoever added the latest note in Overlord. Clicking a document now opens a preview, and downloaded documents keep their real file name.
mac_notes: You can now delete your own admin notes, after a confirmation. Notes typed in the web admin are no longer credited to whoever added the latest note in Overlord. Clicking a document now opens a preview, and downloaded documents keep their real file name.
windows_notes: You can now delete your own admin notes, after a confirmation. Notes typed in the web admin are no longer re-credited to whoever adds the next note. Documents on File now open a preview when clicked, and downloads keep their real file name instead of "download".
